gfx.common.cpEarned: CP = Championship Points. {cp} is a number.
gfx.facts.players: Player count in the small facts line under a graphic's title (type · date · format · players).
gfx.sportsPage.headline: Newspaper headline, printed in capitals. {lastName} is the winner's last name; {event} is the event type (e.g. League Cup) or 'the event'.
gfx.sportsPage.deck: Sub-headline when there is no record. {winner} is the full name; {tournament} is the tournament name or the word 'tournament'.
gfx.sportsPage.colPlace: Column header for placing; very narrow (2–3 letters).
gfx.sportsPage.colRecord: Column header for win-loss record; short abbreviation.
gfx.sportsPage.field: Box label: how many players entered.
gfx.sportsPage.follow: Box label above the winner's social media handle.
gfx.sportsPage.earned: Box label above the Championship Points the winner earned.
